arguments.query: SELECT name, sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table'

SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight_id',b.flight_id,'passenger_id',b.passenger_id,'amount_cents',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status != 'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'charge',json_object('charge_id',c.charge_id,'booking_id',c.booking_id,'idempotency_key',c.idempotency_key,'amount_cents',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created_step',c.created_step) FROM charges c WHERE c.state != 'captured' OR c.booking_id IN (SELECT booking_id FROM bookings WHERE status != 'confirmed') UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox',json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking_id',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status != 'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('flight_id',flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price_cents',price_cents,'version',version) FROM flights UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'cancel',json_object('event_id',event_id,'request_id',request_id,'step',step) FROM customer_events UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('hold_id',hold_id,'flight_id',flight_id,'price_cents',price_cents,'until_step',until_step) FROM fare_holds
